title: The strange-solvent quantities
description: The two quantities the rules of Classes 8 and 9 read besides the acid (GEN.894, docs/design/habitability/life-classes.md 8.3): the ammonia of a body's water, as a share of the water's mass, and whether its crust is silicon-rich. Every number carries its source tier (T1 to T9) and tweak level (L0 to L4) next to it.

nh3_share_of_ice.basis: The share of a body's non-water ice (bulk_composition.ice, the CO2, NH3, CH4, CO, N2 and organics together) that is ammonia: the solar nitrogen to oxygen number ratio of 0.14 would make at most 0.24 of the water's mass if all the nitrogen were ammonia; comet ices hold under 1 percent of water as ammonia and Titan's interior models take about 5 percent; one tenth of the other ices lands between them

silicon_rich_mg_si_max.basis: The molar Mg/Si of the rock at or under which the crust counts as silicon-rich: under 1 the magnesium cannot take all the silicon into olivine and pyroxene, and the rest is free silica ([R0455, R0671] on the stellar Mg/Si of 0.4 to 3, recalled); Earth's bulk is 1.07 (recalled)
